QUOTE: `not_indexed` / `not_indexed_count` present in the reply. | Some files in scope have no `path` rows in this build, so the build could not have indexed them. Types are named with exact counts (top 12 shown).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names file types that were in scope but NOT indexed (no rows), which is the opposite of the item's requirement. The item wants file types that WERE searched/in scope and produced no rows, so that "absent from the repo" differs from "type not indexed". The `scope` block lists extensions, but the answer doesn't say the empty reply names searched types that returned nothing.
